description: Release inputs for the vaccine field-effectiveness scenario. Values as INSP prints them, each with its SitRep locator. No national total. Read by lovs.vaccine_scenario_release.

vaccination_rows_as_printed.source: INSP SitRep 193, page 8: 496 contacts and 4,846 people with no declared contact (special population / BRAVO study)
INSP SitRep 193, page 8: activity continues, no counts printed
INSP SitRep 193, page 8: 4,345 of 5,299 pre-registered front-line workers
INSP SitRep 193: no Tshopo vaccination line printed

Nord-Kivu.name: frontline_workers
Nord-Kivu.mode_source: ASSUMPTION: Nord-Kivu frontline workers were vaccinated ahead of exposure, as a preventive campaign on a frontline-worker target list (SitReps 158-159); a share vaccinated after exposure would lower their timing share below the pre-exposure value of about 0.93

coverage.numerator_source: INSP SitRep 192, page 8: 4,737 PPL of 5,233, the latest printed frontline/contact split
coverage.record_difference: the SitRep 193 record holds 5,342 vaccinated in all, split into 496 contacts and 4,846 with no declared contact (special population / BRAVO study), which is not printed as frontline workers; the group includes BRAVO study vaccinees, as SitReps 191 and 193 label the Nord-Kivu count, and their make-up is not printed, so frontline coverage may be overstated
coverage.denominator_source: INSP SitReps 158 and 159: provincial frontline-worker target
coverage.denominator_assumption: ASSUMPTION: the SitRep 158-159 provincial target of 36,070 still describes Nord-Kivu's frontline workforce about 35 releases later, to within 20 % either way; no later SitRep restates or revises it

coverage.source: ASSUMPTION: share of listed contacts whose ring was reached by vaccination (members already ill at vaccination are counted as unprotected in the ring share, not here); SitRep 193 prints 496 cumulative vaccinated contacts and 15,936 contacts under follow-up (3.1 %, not the same population or period)

pre_exposure_weight.source: ASSUMPTION: share vaccinated ahead of exposure; SitReps 186-187 printed a pre-registered group of 3,300 frontline workers; SitRep 193 prints the vaccinated as PPL (frontline workers), which favours the upper part of the range, and the range is kept

coverage.numerator_source: INSP SitRep 190, page 9: 14,968 vaccinated in Tshopo, the latest printed count (SitReps 191 to 193 print no Tshopo line)
coverage.denominator_assumption: ASSUMPTION: the SitRep 186 target of 14,960 still describes Tshopo's list; SitRep 190 printed 100.1 % with no denominator, and 14,968 / 14,960 = 100.05 %. Vaccination after SitRep 190 is not counted; the cumulative can only have grown, so coverage is if anything understated within the cap at 1. The SitRep 190 record carries no denominator, and 14,960 is SitRep 186's

pre_exposure_weight.source: ASSUMPTION: make-up of Tshopo's 14,968 vaccinated (SitRep 190) is not printed (frontline workers, contacts or others)

coverage.source: ASSUMPTION: share of Ituri's listed contacts whose ring was reached by vaccination. Both ends divide by about 40,900 contacts listed since vaccination began on 19 September (13,214 under follow-up in SitRep 193 Table 4, times 65/21 for a steady 21-day roster). Upper end: the 4,819 vaccinated in SitRep 192 (SitRep 193 prints no Ituri count) is 11.8% if every vaccinee was a listed contact. Lower end: 1.1% if contacts are the same share of vaccinees as in Nord-Kivu, 496 of 5,342 (SitRep 193). SitRep 192 lists 46 pregnant women, 146 breastfeeding women, 21 children aged 1 to 5 and 627 aged 12 to 17 among the 4,819, and no contacts. The roster behind the denominator moves by about 30 % between editions (Ituri contacts under follow-up 12,927 to 16,881 in SitReps 189 to 193); SitRep 191's roster would put the lower end at about 0.009

Bas-Uele.name: target_list
Bas-Uele.mode_source: ASSUMPTION: Bas-Uele's list was vaccinated ahead of exposure; the province has 13 cumulative confirmed cases and none new in SitReps 187-193 (Table 1), so any exposure in the horizon comes after vaccination

coverage.numerator_source: INSP SitRep 186, section 2.6: 2,379 adults vaccinated in Bas-Uele, the latest printed count (SitReps 187-193 print none)
coverage.denominator_source: INSP SitReps 174-176 and 186: Bas-Uele target of 13,202
coverage.denominator_assumption: ASSUMPTION: the 13,202 target printed from SitRep 174 to 186 still describes the list: PPL, read as frontline workers although SitRep 179's own Bas-Uele line expands it as persons deprived of liberty (elsewhere in these SitReps PPL is the frontline workers, and the same hot-meals line reads personnels de premiere ligne in SitReps 181-183; either reading leaves the list unassigned to frontline workers or contacts, so no number depends on it), and target groups (religious leaders, community health workers, traditional healers, motorcycle-taxi drivers and hunters; SitRep 179). Vaccination after SitRep 186 is not counted; SitRep 186 reports the 121 remaining doses as expired

notes: Nord-Kivu coverage uses the latest printed split of vaccinated frontline workers (SitRep 192's 4,737); SitRep 193 splits its 5,342 into 496 contacts and 4,846 with no declared contact (special population / BRAVO study), not frontline workers.
Tshopo prints no vaccination line in SitReps 191 to 193; its coverage is SitRep 190's 14,968 (a reviewed record) over the SitRep 186 target of 14,960, with an assumed range on the target.
Haut-Uele: the pre-registered group grows from 4,428 to 5,299 front-line workers in SitRep 193, so its coverage falls from 86.7 % to 82 % with more people vaccinated.

A share of all cases averted is reported only for Nord-Kivu, where the vaccinated are split into frontline workers and contacts. Elsewhere the vaccinated are not split into frontline workers and contacts.

Values taken from earlier SitReps (3,300 from SitReps 186-187; 14,960 and Bas-Uele's 2,379 and 13,202 from SitRep 186) are as printed and checked by hand; they are not in a reviewed promotion record, so the record parity check does not cover them. The 36,070 target is in the reviewed SitRep 158 and 159 records, and Tshopo's 14,968 in the reviewed SitRep 190 record.
Ituri: SitRep 193 prints no Ituri count; the range uses SitRep 192's 4,819 over this edition's roster.

Bas-Uele is not in the SitRep 193 vaccination record; its 2,379 and 13,202 are as printed in SitRep 186 and checked by hand. PPL means frontline workers (personnels de premiere ligne) in most SitReps. It is also expanded as persons deprived of liberty (SitReps 179 and 180, where the same hot-meals line reads personnels de premiere ligne in SitReps 181-183), as a special population (SitRep 183, Nord-Kivu) and as the most exposed populations (SitReps 182-183, Ituri).
